72cnkcs4nhg2nSELECT df.CON_NAME, df.TABLESPACE_NAME AS TABLESPACE, df.CONTENTS AS TYPE, NVL(SUM(df.BYTES), :"SYS_B_00") AS FILE_BYTES, NVL(SUM(df.MAX_BYTES), :"SYS_B_01") AS MAX_BYTES, NVL(SUM(f.FREE), :"SYS_B_02") AS FREE_BYTES, NVL(SUM(df.BYTES) - MAX(Y.FREE_BYTES), :"SYS_B_33") AS USED_BYTES, ROUND(CASE SUM(Y.MAX_BYTES) WHEN :"SYS_B_34" THEN :"SYS_B_35" ELSE (SUM(Y.BYTES) / SUM(Y.MAX_BYTES) * :"SYS_B_36") END, :"SYS_B_37") AS USED_PCT_MAX, ROUND(CASE SUM(Y.BYTES) WHEN :"SYS_B_38" THEN :"SYS_B_39" ELSE (NVL(SUM(Y.BYTES) - MAX(Y.FREE_BYTES), :"SYS_B_40")) / SUM(Y.BYTES) * :"SYS_B_41" END, :"SYS_B_42") AS USED_FILE_PCT, ROUND(CASE SUM(Y.MAX_BYTES) WHEN :"SYS_B_43" THEN :"SYS_B_44" ELSE (NVL(SUM(Y.BYTES) - MAX(Y.FREE_BYTES), :"SYS_B_45")) / SUM(Y.MAX_BYTES) * :"SYS_B_46" END, :"SYS_B_47") AS USED_FROM_MAX_PCT, CASE Y.STATUS WHEN :"SYS_B_48" THEN :"SYS_B_49" WHEN :"SYS_B_50" THEN :"SYS_B_51" WHEN :"SYS_B_52" THEN :"SYS_B_53" ELSE :"SYS_B_54" END AS STATUS FROM (SELECT ct.CON$NAME AS CON_NAME, ctf.TABLESPACE_NAME AS NAME, ct.CONTENTS, ctf.STATUS AS STATUS, ctf.BYTES AS BYTES, (SELECT ((f.TOTAL_BLOCKS - s.TOT_USED_BLOCKS) * vp.VALUE) FROM (SELECT CON_ID, TABLESPACE_NAME, SUM(USED_BLOCKS) TOT_USED_BLOCKS FROM V$SORT_SEGMENT WHERE TABLESPACE_NAME != :"SYS_B_55" GROUP BY CON_ID, TABLESPACE_NAME) s, (SELECT CON_ID, TABLESPACE_NAME, SUM(BLOCKS) TOTAL_BLOCKS FROM CDB_TEMP_FILES WHERE TABLESPACE_NAME != :"SYS_B_56" GROUP BY CON_ID, TABLESPACE_NAME) f, (SELECT VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME = :"SYS_B_57") vp WHERE f.TABLESPACE_NAME = s.TABLESPACE_NAME AND f.TABLESPACE_NAME = ctf.TABLESPACE_NAME AND f.CON_ID = s.CON_ID AND f.CON_ID = ct.CON_ID) AS FREE_BYTES, CASE WHEN ctf.MAXBYTES = :"SYS_B_58" THEN ctf.BYTES ELSE ctf.MAXBYTES END AS MAX_BYTES FROM CDB_TEMP_FILES ctf, CDB_TABLESPACES ct WHERE ctf.TABLESPACE_NAME = ct.TABLESPACE_NAME AND ctf.CON_ID = ct.CON_ID AND (ct.CON_ID = :"SYS_B_59" or (ct.CON$NAME is null and ct.CON_ID = :"SYS_B_60")) AND ctf.TABLESPACE_NAME = :"SYS_B_61" AND ct.CONTENTS = :"SYS_B_62") Y GROUP BY Y.CON_NAME, Y.NAME, Y.CONTENTS, Y.STATUS
